issue_request: FHIR-27884 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core StructureDefinition change request to correct the $questionnaire operation so identifier is Identifier rather than canonical and profile is Resource (StructureDefinition) rather than string.
initial_application: Jira records commit b251978797 as the application. That commit changed source/structuredefinition/operationdefinition-StructureDefinition-questionnaire.xml from canonical/string to Identifier/StructureDefinition, and the v5.0.0 source retained those corrected types.
additional_context: StructureDefinition is still active in source/fhir.ini, but the current StructureDefinition operation list includes only OperationDefinition/StructureDefinition-snapshot. Commit 270e0ceb7b removed OperationDefinition/StructureDefinition-questionnaire from the list and deleted its source file during R6 normative cleanup. Current source grep finds no $questionnaire OperationDefinition under source/structuredefinition, only the historical OID registry entry. FHIR-I minutes mention moving FHIR-27884 to SDC, and no quoted Zulip or Confluence FTS result contradicted the Jira/source history.
reconciliation: No source edit was made. The requested incorrect parameter types are not present in current FHIR core source because the previously fixed operation is now outside the current core build.
